verdict.rationale: The evidence documents an official MCP server, a remote MCP endpoint, and an Agent Toolkit SDK on npm, but nothing describes an official command-line interface. An SDK or MCP server is a different surface and earns no credit toward a CLI story. A payments platform could plausibly ship a CLI, so the axis applies and the missing evidence yields none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
